name: @datum-cloud/workloads-provider-plugin
description: Workloads resource-type plugin: declares a portal.resource/platform extension so staff-portal's /customers/resources page can list compute Workloads across every project via Milo's search index, a portal.page/project extension (WorkloadDetail/WorkloadList) — a staff support view of a single workload's health, configuration, placements, and instances — and two portal.page/service extensions: a fleet-wide Workloads tab and an Overview-replacing summary, both on staff-portal's /admin/service-catalog/compute detail page.
